title: The Assets window
summary: The Assets button opens a window listing the project's assets with their details, and lets you preview, place or export them.
alternateQueries: How do I preview an asset?
How do I export an asset?

blocks.text: Click Assets in the header. The window has three tabs: Project Assets, Asset Store and Shared Assets. The last two are placeholders (coming soon).

Project Assets lists the current project's assets with a Refresh button. Select one to see its details on the right: kind, path, size, modified time and, when recorded, length, picture size, frame rate, sample rate and channels. Details come from the project's records, so selecting an asset does not open the file.

blocks.definition: Opens the asset in the panel that suits it (for example a patch in the Signal Lab) or plays an audio asset.
Puts the asset on the selected track at the playhead.
Saves an audio asset to a file you choose.

blocks.text: Editing an asset's display name and description is not available yet.
